mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Defensive Ball Curl</titleLeft><mainText>Rammus is in a defensive ball curl. His Armor and Magic Resist are increased, the power of Spiked Shell is increased, and he returns damage to enemies that basic attack him.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Rammus goes into a defensive formation, vastly increasing his Armor and Magic Resistance, and returning damage to enemies that attack him.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Rammus enters a defensive formation for @BuffDuration@ seconds, gaining @BonusArmorTooltip@ Armor and @BonusMRTooltip@ Magic Resist and dealing @ReturnDamageCalc@ magic damage to enemies that Attack him.

Recast: Rammus ends this Ability early.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Powerball</titleLeft><mainText>Rammus is accelerating and on impact he will slow and knock back enemies around him.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Rammus accelerates in a ball towards his enemies, dealing damage and slowing targets affected by the impact.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Rammus curls into a ball, gaining @MinimumMoveSpeed@ Move Speed, accelerating up to @MaximumMoveSpeed@ Move Speed over @RollDuration@ seconds. Rammus stops after colliding with an enemy, dealing @PowerBallDamage@ magic damage, Knocking Back, and Slowing nearby enemies by @SlowPercent@% for @SlowDuration@ second.

Recast: Rammus ends this Ability early.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Powerball</titleLeft><mainText>Rammus is accelerating and on impact he will slow and knock back enemies around him.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Rammus taunts an enemy champion or monster into a reckless assault against him.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Rammus <status>Taunts</status> an enemy champion or monster for @Duration@ seconds. Monsters are dealt <magicDamage>@MonsterDamageCalc@ magic damage</magicDamage>.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Rammus gains bonus Attack Damage scaling with his Armor and Magic Resistance.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Powerball</titleLeft><mainText>Rammus is accelerating and on impact he will slow and knock back enemies around him.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

<titleLeft>Soaring Slam</titleLeft><mainText>Soaring Slam creates aftershocks beneath Rammus, which cause damage to nearby enemies and slow them. Turrets take double damage from the aftershocks.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Rammus hops into the air and slams down at a target area, dealing magic damage and slowing enemies. If cast while Rammus is in Powerball, Rammus knocks up enemies near the center as well.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Rammus hops into the air and slams down in an area, dealing @InitialDamageCalc@ magic damage and Slowing by @SlowAmount*100@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds. If used during Powerball, enemies in the center take an additional @spell.PowerBall:PowerBallDamage@ magic damage and are Knocked Up for @KnockupDuration@ seconds.

Rammus then creates @NumberOfPulses@ aftershocks in the area over @BuffDuration@ seconds, repeating the Slow.

The range of this Ability is increased by Rammus's Move Speed.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Soaring Slam Slow</titleLeft><mainText>Soaring Slam applies a slow.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
